## Activity

North City Eye Clinic recorded 617 captures during November 2025. This report summarises activity at the site for the month, including image quality outcomes and grading results. The recorded capture volume provides the basis for reviewing the proportion of images suitable for assessment and the number of results requiring referral.

## Image quality

Of the images captured, 13 were marked ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 2.1. The result indicates that most captures were available for grading, while a smaller number could not be assessed from the images obtained. The site should continue to monitor image quality as part of routine operations. Staff raised no new equipment faults this month.

## Grading

Grading identified 168 referable results. The median lag from capture to grading was 2. This measure records the typical interval between image capture and completion of grading. Together, the grading volume and turnaround measure provide a summary of the month’s referral activity and processing performance at North City Eye Clinic.
